'''Impulse detector units''' were a type of [[Impulse detector/Legends|impulse detector]]. A single unit included a flat base with a grill above it on the device's front with a triangular central surface in the center of the grill. A series of protrusions extended from the top of the device, which was dark [[Color/Legends|gray]], including a signal clarifier and a receiver [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Tubing ran from each side of the device back round to the rear.<ref name="TPM" />

An impulse detector unit was sat on the counter of the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] [[Wald's Parts|junkshop]]<ref name="TPM" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when aa group led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] entered the store in search of a [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14 hyperdrive generator]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
An impulse detector unit appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The device was first identified in the reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], written by West Reynolds<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> and released on [[May 26]], 1999.<ref name="Amazon">{{CollectorCite|6|Books with Bite}}</ref>
